title: Explain a Meal for Guests

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料，尚待发布前独立审核。

instructions: Write your own first draft; the fictional example is for study, not your submission.
prompt: Write 120–160 words explaining a simple meal you would prepare for a small group. Describe the ingredients, the order of preparation, how you would check guests’ needs, and how you would serve it. Use at least six lesson words and one expression with a few, a little, too much, too many or enough.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Use four parts: guests and food needs; ingredients; preparation steps; serving and checking. Keep the example separate from your own draft.

reference: I would prepare a simple vegetable meal for four friends. Before shopping, I would ask whether anyone needs to avoid a particular ingredient. I would choose a potato, a carrot, an onion, a tomato and some cooked beans. First, I would wash the vegetables, peel the potato and chop the onion. Then I would fry the onion in a little oil and add the other vegetables. I would boil the potato separately and mix it with the beans. Before serving, I would taste the dish and add a little pepper if everyone agreed. I would keep cheese in a separate bowl, so each person could choose. I would also bake enough bread for the group and explain what is in the meal.
